description:
This file defines the ContentBottom controller class in the Opencart
amespace, responsible for rendering the content bottom section of the website layout by loading relevant modules and views.

classes.name: ContentBottom
classes.description: Controller class for rendering the content bottom section of the layout, loading modules and assembling data for view rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads necessary models, determines the layout ID based on route parameters, loads content modules assigned to 'content_bottom' position, and renders the 'common/content_bottom' view with gathered data.
